metadata.name: CORE — Project economics
metadata.activacion: User request, contractual need, or complexity at or above MODERATE when the user supplied rates or effort data. A TRIVIAL or SIMPLE fix does not activate this module.

prohibiciones.regla: Do not invent hourly rates, salaries, velocity, actual hours, cloud prices, or model prices.
Do not assume a country, a currency, or an exchange rate. Ask.
Do not present a preliminary estimate as an approved budget or as actual expenditure.
Do not compute CPI or SPI when EV, AC, or PV is missing.
Do not overwrite an approved baseline. Changes go to a change-cost analysis.
Do not modify the canonical backlog or the 22-column extended CSV. Economics is a companion file.
Unverified provider prices are PROVISIONAL and name the assumed rate.

formulas.formula: Sum of actual hours by role times the hourly rate of that role. Units: currency.
Sum of estimated hours by role times the hourly rate of that role.
Available productive hours times available contributors. Subtract leave, holidays, meetings, and apply a stated focus factor.
Accepted story points divided by completed sprints. Not points merely marked done.
Sum of effort by role times the hourly rate of that role.
EV divided by AC. Invalid when AC is zero or missing.
EV divided by PV. Invalid when PV is zero or missing.
BAC divided by CPI, when past cost performance is expected to continue.
AC plus BAC minus EV, when the variance is a one-off.
Expected equals (optimistic plus 4 times most likely plus pessimistic) divided by 6. Sigma is about (pessimistic minus optimistic) divided by 6. Label it as an assumption.

prompt.metodos: Analogous, parametric from real history, bottom-up, three-point, relative sizing. COCOMO II is only an orientative cross-check. Record the method. A flat contingency percentage is STANDARD_ASSUMPTION.
prompt.contenido_obligatorio: Method, sources, assumptions, exclusions, confidence, low/expected/high range, cost drivers, risks, sensitivity, date, revision history, and the class: preliminary, refined, approved baseline, actual, or forecast.

salidas.regla: Generate only the files the activation and the available data justify. Living files are updated in place. An approved baseline is snapshotted and not edited.
